title: Augmentation-normalized internal-Hom comparison for slice restriction
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on C with independent object and morphism universes c,v. Let A be a commutative ring sheaf with values in max(c,v,u), with module sheafification and locally bijective sheafification equivalences. Fix an object U and derived categories of module sheaves on J and J.over U in independent universes w,w'. For the fixed derived internal Homs H,HU and exact derived slice restriction r of [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model], there exists a natural isomorphism eta: H followed by r isomorphic to (r.op product r) followed by HU. For every complex L and every K-injective complex I there are isomorphisms kappa: H(QL,QI) isomorphic to Q Hom(L,I), kappaU for the restricted complexes, and gamma: R Hom(L,I) isomorphic to Hom(RL,RI). Both kappa isomorphisms obey RingedKInjectiveHomModel, the equation with the fixed K-injective augmentation. On each local family the gamma component at V over U, degree n and component L^p to I^q with p+n=q evaluates over W over V to the original component evaluated over Over.mk(W.hom.left). The square with r(kappa), ringedSliceLocalizationIso, Q(gamma), eta, transport by the two argument localization isomorphisms, and kappaU commutes, in the order displayed in the Lean statement. No tensor model, closed structure, symmetry, K-flatness or flat terms are assumed.

proof.text: The existing presheaf internal-Hom restriction isomorphism identifies relocalized families of module maps. Bundle the actual Hom-complex functor, object maps and product projections with their proved limit, differential and map equations. Restriction preserves the integer-indexed products because it is a right adjoint. Product universal properties and the two-term differential equation give the ordinary chain isomorphism. The component equation proves simultaneous naturality and, evaluated over an object of the twice-localized site, exactly the displayed local-family normalization.

Use the existing ordinary-to-derived Hom comparison, its naturality and its invertibility for K-injective targets. Restriction preserves K-injectivity by the independent-universe restriction theorem. After applying functorial K-injective replacement to the target, both comparisons are invertible, as are the images of the augmentations. Compose these four isomorphisms and descend along Q.op product Q using fully faithful whiskering. Naturality with respect to the augmentation proves the equation characterizing the descended isomorphism on all complexes.

For a K-injective target, invert the fixed ordinary-to-derived comparison to obtain kappa. Its factorization through the fixed augmentation proves RingedKInjectiveHomModel by cancelling the augmentation map and the resolution isomorphism. Do the same on the slice. The descent equation from the preceding step, with the two inverse identifications substituted, gives the required square by cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms. No representative or resolution is chosen from an undetermined existence assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSlice_homComparison_exists
    (U : C) [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))] :
    ∃ η : derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A ⋙
        ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U ≅
      ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).op.prod
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U)) ⋙
          derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U),
  ∀ (L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v
      u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj A)) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective],
      ∃ (κ : (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A).obj
            (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj (homComplex (R := A) L I))
        (κU : (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)).obj
          (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj L)),
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj I)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (homComplex (R := A.over U)
            ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj L)
            ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj I)))
        (γ : (ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj (homComplex (R := A) L I) ≅
          homComplex (R := A.over U) ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj L)
            ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj I)),
        RingedKInjectiveHomModel.{c, v, u, w} J A L I κ ∧
        RingedKInjectiveHomModel.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)
          ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj L)
          ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj I) κU ∧
        (∀ (n p q : ℤ) (h : p + n = q) (V : Over U)
          (W : Over V) (x : (L.X p).val.obj (op W.left.left))
          (z : ((homComplex (R := A) L I).X n).val.obj (op V.left)),
          (((coefficientHomComponent.{u, max c v, v} (J.over U) (A.over U)
            ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj L)
            ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj I) n p q h).val.app (op V)
              ((γ.hom.f n).val.app (op V) z)).app (op W)).hom x =
          (((coefficientHomComponent.{u, c, v} J A L I n p q h).val.app (op V.left) z).app
            (op (Over.mk W.hom.left))).hom x) ∧
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).map κ.hom ≫
          (ringedSliceLocalizationIso.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).hom.app (homComplex (R := A) L I) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map γ.hom =
        η.hom.app (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫
          (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)).map
            (X := (op ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)), (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)))
            (Y := (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj L)),
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj I)))
            (((ringedSliceLocalizationIso.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).inv.app L).op,
              (ringedSliceLocalizationIso.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).hom.app I) ≫ κU.hom
